name: mbarrier
title: mbarrier
intro: How the model treats `mbarrier` objects: what each instruction does to an object, which executions are allowed, and what counts as an error. Concepts come first, then the rules.
concepts_intro: The definitions a reader needs to follow the rules. Each text is the Lean doc comment, and each entry links to its Lean source.
rules_intro: Each rule is a contract block of the Lean source. Its statement says what the rule means for programs. The source quotes the PTX ISA 9.5 text the rule rests on, and the direction says how the rule relates to that text. Interpretations (EXT) are readings of the PTX text that the model adopts beyond what the text states. The fields that reviewers check against the Lean bodies are collected under Details for reviewers.
